title: AeroVision Initiative: NextGen Automated AI Systems

sections.abstract: QuantumVision pioneers quantum-inspired diffusion models for automated tumor margin delineation with sub-millimeter precision in magnetic resonance scans.
sections.scientific_methodology: Our network architecture combines spatial attention with quantum tensor decomposition to process multi-spectral volumetric clinical imaging.
sections.impact_and_dissemination: Clinical validation in 3 hospital research wards with potential to accelerate radiology diagnosis workflows by 30%.
sections.work_packages: WP1: Diffusion models. WP2: Hospital clinical validation. WP3: Regulatory software submission.
sections.budget: Budget allocates €600,000 for external outsourced testing subcontracting (20.3%). Indirect costs requested total €600,000 to cover full departmental administration.
